prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck and back strain after a hit while turning left. The patient had 15 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1488; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a motor vehicle collision in which their vehicle was struck from the side while turning left. Complaints centered on neck and back pain consistent with a cervical and lumbar strain. The mechanism of injury and the force involved are well matched to the symptoms reported. Over the course of 15 office visits, care consisted of manual therapy, guided home exercise, and short-term anti-inflammatory medication. Treatment followed a typical progression, with visit frequency and symptom intensity decreasing as the patient improved and range of motion returned. Examination revealed some objective findings supporting soft tissue injury, including paraspinal muscle tenderness and reduced cervical rotation, while other orthopedic and neurological tests were within normal limits. The patient reports no prior injury or treatment to the neck or low back. Billing records reflect single, appropriate charges for each service rendered, with no duplicate entries. At the time of discharge, the patient was improving and was advised to continue independent exercise as needed.
